translations.literal: On the day Renzi, the Prince of Pengcheng, Xiong, and the Prince of Zhangwu, Xiu, rebelled and fled to Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day Renzi, Prince Xiong of Pengcheng and Prince Xiu of Zhangwu defected and fled to Su Jun.

sentences.zh: 雄，釋之子也。

translations.literal: Xiong was a son of Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong was a son of Shi.

sentences.zh: 庚申，京師戒嚴，假庾亮節，都督征討諸軍事；

translations.literal: On the day Gengshen the capital was placed under martial law; Yu Liang was given the staff of authority and made commander of all forces for the punitive campaign;
translations.idiomatic: On the day Gengshen the capital was placed under martial law; Yu Liang was granted the staff of authority and placed in command of all forces for the punitive campaign;

sentences.zh: 以左衛將軍趙胤為歷陽太守，使左將軍司馬流將兵據慈湖以拒峻。

translations.literal: General of the Left Guard Zhao Yin was made Administrator of Liyang, and Major of the Left General Si Ma Liu was sent to lead troops to hold Cihu in order to resist Jun.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Left Guard Zhao Yin was appointed administrator of Liyang, and Major Sima Liu of the Left General was sent to hold Cihu against Su Jun.

sentences.zh: 以前射聲校尉劉超為左衛將軍，侍中褚翜典征討軍事。

translations.literal: Former Commandant of the Archers Liu Chao was made General of the Left Guard, and Palace Attendant Chu Xu directed the military affairs of the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Former Commandant of the Archers Liu Chao was made general of the left guard, and Palace Attendant Chu Xu took charge of the campaign's military affairs.

sentences.zh: 亮使弟翼以白衣領數百人備石頭。

translations.literal: Liang had his younger brother Yi, in plain dress, lead several hundred men to guard Stone City.
translations.idiomatic: Liang had his younger brother Yi, wearing plain clothes, lead several hundred men to defend Stone City.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，徙琅邪王昱為會稽王，吳王岳為琅邪王。

translations.literal: On the day Bingyin, the Prince of Langya, Yu, was moved to be Prince of Kuaiji, and the Prince of Wu, Yue, was made Prince of Langya.
translations.idiomatic: On the day Bingyin, Prince Yu of Langya was reassigned as Prince of Kuaiji, and Prince Yue of Wu was made Prince of Langya.

sentences.zh: 宣城內史桓彝欲起兵以赴朝廷，其長史裨惠以郡兵寡弱，山民易擾，謂宜且按甲以待之。

translations.literal: Huan Yi, Interior Minister of Xuancheng, wished to raise troops to go to the court's aid; his chief clerk Bi Hui held that the commandery's forces were few and weak and the mountain people easily stirred to disorder, and said they should for the present hold their arms and wait.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Yi, interior minister of Xuancheng, wished to raise troops to march to the court's aid; his chief clerk Bi Hui argued that the commandery's forces were too few and the hill tribes too easily provoked, and urged that they hold their troops in check for the time being.

sentences.zh: 彝厲色曰：「『見無禮於其君者，若鷹鸇之逐鳥雀。』

translations.literal: Yi said sternly, "'When one sees a man rude to his lord, it is like a hawk or falcon pursuing sparrows.'
translations.idiomatic: Yi said sternly, "'When one sees a man show disrespect to his lord, it is like a hawk pursuing sparrows.'

sentences.zh: 今社稷危逼，義無宴安。」

translations.literal: Now the altars of state are in peril—there is no room for ease and comfort."
translations.idiomatic: The altars of state are in peril—there is no excuse for ease and comfort."

sentences.zh: 辛未，彝進屯蕪湖。

translations.literal: On the day Xinwei, Yi advanced and encamped at Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day Xinwei, Yi advanced and encamped at Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 韓晃擊破之，因進攻宣城，彝退保廣德，晃大掠諸縣而還。

translations.literal: Han Huang defeated him, then advanced to attack Xuancheng; Yi withdrew to defend Guangde; Huang plundered the commanderies greatly and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Han Huang defeated him, then pressed on against Xuancheng; Yi fell back to hold Guangde; Huang plundered the surrounding counties heavily and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史郗鑒欲帥所領赴難，詔以北寇，不許。

translations.literal: Xi Jian, Inspector of Xuzhou, wished to lead his command to the rescue, but an edict cited the northern invaders and forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jian, inspector of Xuzhou, wished to lead his troops to the rescue, but an edict cited the threat from the north and refused permission.

sentences.zh: 是歲，後趙中山公虎擊代王紇那，戰於句注陘北；

translations.literal: That year, Shi Hu, Duke of Zhongshan of Later Zhao, attacked the lord of Dai, Henai, and fought north of Gouzhu Pass;
translations.idiomatic: That year, Shi Hu, Duke of Zhongshan of Later Zhao, attacked the lord of Dai, Henai, and fought north of Gouzhu Pass;

sentences.zh: 紇那兵敗，徙都大寧以避之。

translations.literal: Henai's army was defeated and he moved his capital to Daning to avoid him.
translations.idiomatic: Henai was defeated and moved his capital to Daning to escape him.

sentences.zh: 代王鬱律之子翳槐居於其舅賀蘭部，紇那遣使求之，賀蘭大人藹頭擁護不遣。

translations.literal: Yihuai, son of the lord of Dai Yulü, lived among his maternal uncle's Helan tribe; Henai sent envoys to request him, but the Helan chieftain Aitou shielded him and would not send him away.
translations.idiomatic: Yihuai, son of the late lord Yulü of Dai, lived with his maternal uncle's Helan tribe; Henai sent envoys to demand his return, but the Helan chieftain Aitou protected him and refused to hand him over.

sentences.zh: 紇那與宇文部共擊藹頭，不克。

translations.literal: Henai joined with the Yuwen tribe to attack Aitou but could not overcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Henai allied with the Yuwen tribe to attack Aitou but failed to defeat him.
